recap.text: Geraldo is a Monk Seal Picket Sentry who flips through the air shouting kung-fu sound effects. He wears a white headband with red hearts. Geraldo cracked the shell of Raul the crab after saying something about Raul's mother. He now calls Raul the spider lady's jinetera.

beats.headline: He joins the squad
beats.text: Subject is a Monk Seal Picket Sentry, an aquatic mob built to stand in front of things. He was taken rather than recruited. Summoned, he wears a white headband with red hearts on it matching the team flag, which he did not own when he was captured, and he flips through the air shouting his own kung-fu sound effects. That part came with the species.
beats.gist: Geraldo, a Monk Seal Picket Sentry, joins the squad after being taken.

beats.headline: About Raul's mother
beats.text: Practice record: Subject tanks well and follows orders, except when Raul the crab is also on the field. They came to blows once, when Subject said something about Raul's mother. Raul had the upper hand, stopped the moment Princess Donut told them to, and Subject cracked his shell and finished him. Donut made him apologise at the next summoning. Subject now calls Raul the spider lady's jinetera, after hearing from Shi Maria how she used him as a cudgel.
beats.gist: Geraldo tanks and follows orders unless Raul the crab is present.
